topic: The mangaka who hand-drew 10000 pages before anyone read a single one
hook: He drew 10,000 pages before anyone read a single one.
script: He drew 10,000 pages before anyone read a single one. Kentaro Miura began Berserk in 1989. His level of detail was extraordinary — single panels took weeks to draw. He produced over 10,000 pages of manga by hand over 32 years. He died in 2021 before finishing it. His assistants completed the series using his detailed notes. Every page was a lifetime of craft. The ending existed. He just ran out of time. Follow for mangaka stories about obsession and artistry.
